summary: Explore a multi-theme direction for En UI through an opt-in Storybook vertical slice covering default light, default dark, neobrutalism, glassmorphism, neumorphism, Bauhaus, terminal, editorial, pop, and high-contrast styles without changing public component APIs or the published theme contract.

components: Exercise Avatar, Badge, Button, Checkbox, Input, Kbd, Page layout, Select, and Table without changing their public props, anatomy, protected behavior, or source contracts.
consumers: No consumer impact in this exploratory pass because the themes are not exported or included in the package stylesheet.
contracts: No direct impact in the exploratory slice; public theme contracts remain unchanged until a direction is reviewed and explicitly approved.
documentation: Record feasibility, token-system limitations, accessibility risks, and the work required to promote selected directions into supported themes.
foundations: Prototype alternative palettes, radii, elevation, surface translucency, and typography treatment through Storybook-only overrides of the existing CSS-variable foundation.
patterns: Use one dense renewal-operations composition as the representative vertical slice so every visual direction is evaluated against the same hierarchy, records, controls, and responsive behavior.
screenshots: Produce candidate Storybook previews for human comparison; do not update or approve pixel baselines as part of this exploration.

verticalSlice.name: Multi-theme operations dashboard
verticalSlice.workflow: Scan ten renewal records, filter operational data, select accounts, compare risk and ownership, review activity and capacity, and trigger playbook actions across the proposed visual directions.
verticalSlice.evidence: Storybook theme toolbar, a responsive comparison story, a built Storybook, deterministic repository checks, and human review before any public contract or baseline change.
